item.name: Hand of Midas

effects.title: Transmute
effects.text:
Kills a non-hero target for 160 gold. Killing a neutral creep additionally grants a madstone bundle. 

 Cannot be used on Ancient creeps.

notes: The gold given is unreliable gold (you do not get the normal creep bounty).
Experience gained by using Transmute is not shared.
item.lore: Preserved through unknown magical means, the Hand of Midas is a weapon of greed, sacrificing animals to line the owner's pockets.
